4. Seva Wing: Legal Wing | Advocate

🇮🇳 THE 1947 MAHA SEVA DAL PLEDGE:
'I solemnly pledge to dedicate my service toward the foundational ideals of Maha Seva Dal: Unity of People, selfless social welfare, youth empowerment, and communal harmony without bias of caste, creed, or regional differences.'

Tap 'Confirm & Take Oath' to submit:

🏛️ Maha Seva Dal was founded in 1947 in the crucible of Indian Independence.

Inspired by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, our cadre provided relief camps during the Partition crisis and has served the nation across seven decades of civic and emergency humanitarian seva.

Our motto: Discipline · Service · Unity.
